title: DOM XSS in search results (Juice Shop)

ticket.title: Search term is rendered as trusted HTML in the search results
ticket.problem_statement: The search results component takes the q query parameter and binds it into the view as trusted HTML (the value is passed through a sanitizer bypass and rendered via [innerHTML]). A search term containing an <iframe>/<script> payload executes in the user's browser (DOM-based XSS). The search term must be rendered as text, not bypassed HTML.
acceptance_criteria: A search term containing HTML/script is shown as literal text
Normal search terms still render correctly

pass_criteria: Research identifies SearchResultComponent.filterTable as the DOM XSS sink
Fix renders the search term as text (no sanitizer bypass / innerHTML)
bypassSecurityTrustHtml is no longer applied to the query parameter

title: Admin section reachable by forced browsing (Juice Shop)

ticket.title: Administration section is accessible to non-admin users
ticket.problem_statement: The store's administration section can be reached by a regular customer. Access is gated only by a client-side check that trusts the role claim inside the locally decoded JWT, which is bypassable, and supporting APIs do not re-check the admin role server-side. Admin access must be enforced with a real role check (server-side authorization), not a client-decoded token claim.
acceptance_criteria: A non-admin (customer) JWT cannot load the admin UI or admin APIs

pass_criteria: Research identifies the AdminGuard client-side role check and the unguarded admin API
Fix enforces the admin role server-side (not just a client-decoded JWT claim)
Customer tokens can no longer reach the admin section or its APIs

title: Unsigned (alg:none) JWT accepted (Juice Shop)

ticket.title: JWT verification does not pin the algorithm and accepts unsigned tokens
ticket.problem_statement: Token verification calls the JWT verify routine without pinning the expected algorithm, so a token using 'alg:none' (no signature) is accepted. An attacker can forge an essentially unsigned token and impersonate any user. Verification must enforce the expected signing algorithm and reject unsigned tokens.
acceptance_criteria: JWT verification pins the signing algorithm

pass_criteria: Research identifies the verify() routine in lib/insecurity.ts
Fix pins the JWT algorithm and rejects unsigned tokens
alg:none tokens are no longer accepted
